claim_boundary: Read-only, source-pinned connection inventory. No full-shape token, HBM attention serving, sustained rate or P&R verdict.

ownership_proposal.attention_owner: descriptor lifecycle and packed adapter ready/beat completion contract
ownership_proposal.die_packed_kv_owner: window/CKV DMA plus row merger hookup and selected/remote source tags
ownership_proposal.fullshape_core_owner: source-check connection manifest and L0 arithmetic harness once interfaces freeze
ownership_proposal.fullshape_emitter_owner: emit SEL base/source count and exact dependency before attention; L0 T0 has no selected rows
ownership_proposal.index_owner: paired IDX_SHARDED propagation and exact image gate
ownership_proposal.qe_hbm_owner: propagate W_HAW and source-mode capacity through qstream/die/PHY comparator path
ownership_proposal.root_architecture: approve VM port arbitration, per-die HBM region layout, remote CKV transport and production memory capacity

required_ports.index: one die IDX_SHARDED parameter passed to both pooled reader and key writer; index image uses matching layout
required_ports.packed_attention: 4x16x265 bit beat, 4-bit prefix mask, valid/ready, fault and completion; window/CKV row merger is the source
required_ports.remote_ckv: source ID, owner die, local row, user/layer/generation, valid/ready and tagged packed 288-byte response through real fabric
required_ports.selected_vm: arbitrated 32-bit VM read request/response with SEL_base+i address; TP final select and local-index-to-global-ID transform precede one ID per row; no golden ID injection
required_ports.weight_hbm: W_HAW>=26 from qstream through die/PHY/model; capacity/placement covers at least 65,242,240 selected-image sectors

required_transitions: IDLE: accept one new KVD generation and latch pos/user/rows/SEL base; repeated S_DEC assertions must not create duplicate jobs
STAGE: derive W=min(pos+1,128), selected=T-W; transform RTL local scan indices into global CKV IDs after real TP final selection, then read SEL VM in order and validate source_count/owner
READY: assert kv_ok only for the matching descriptor after initial packed rows are serviceable; never accept an unqualified late ready
STREAM: send ceil(T/4) ordered 4-row beats; final mask is a prefix; count only valid&&ready and hold payload under backpressure
DRAIN: wait for row merger completion and attention engine idle; clear generation and readiness before the next descriptor
FAULT: hold fail-closed on stale generation, address/region violation, bad source ID, remote mismatch or wrong beat count
